تقارنت (form VI)

# تَقَارَنْتَ (taqāranta) /ta.qaː.ran.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَارَنَ (taqārana)
# تَقَارَنْتِ (taqāranti) /ta.qaː.ran.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَارَنَ (taqārana)
# تَقَارَنَتْ (taqāranat) /ta.qaː.ra.nat/: third-person fem
